text:
maya (support): Heads-up — Acme PROD hitting 502s to our private API since cert rotation last night (02:10 UTC). They run Redwood Private in their VPC. Symptoms: intermittent TLS handshakes, a lot of upstream 502s from our edge. Can SRE + infra look?

acme-sre: We're seeing the same. Rotation completed but traffic spiked 502s ~02:12-02:40. Quick repro from our side:
```
$ curl -v https://api.acme.internal/health
* Connected to service.vip.company.net (10.12.34.56) port 443 (#0)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (2)
* error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert handshake failure
* Closing connection 0
```
We also ran `openssl s_client -connect service.vip.company.net:443 -showcerts` and one backend returned only the leaf cert (missing intermediate). Full output attached in DM.

liam (sre): @acme-sre can you paste the exact openssl output inline? Also do you have egress allowlist that could block OCSP/CRL fetches? Missing intermediates usually show as `verify return:1` vs `verify return:0` in s_client.

acme-sre: pasted snippet:
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = api.redwood.acme
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
verify return:1
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
...leaf...
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
```
So verify error:num=20. We do have strict egress allowlist; outgoing to public CA OCSP was allowed but only via proxy at 10.11.0.5.

jenna (infra): Rotator audit shows job `rotator:acme-org:2026-03-16T02:09Z` completed BUT agent `lb-03.eu-west-1` failed to upload the concatenated bundle due to transient write error. The control plane recorded success because 2/3 agents applied, but lb-03 kept the old bundle. TL;DR: one load-balancer still serving old chain.

rotator-bot: Rotation job acme-org-2026-03-16T02:09Z finished with warnings. Failed agents: lb-03.eu-west-1. Logs: https://rotator.internal/jobs/12345

maya (support): Can infra restart haproxy on lb-03 and force re-deploy of the rotated bundle? Workaround for customer is to add the intermediate to their client CA bundle, or point traffic to healthy VIP if they have SRV with multiple endpoints.

jenna (infra): Doing rolling restart on lb-03 now. Also increasing rotator retry window to handle transient agent write errors. Will push a fix to ensure bundle verification on agent after apply.

kevin (oncall): Confirming — after restart 502 rate dropped from ~65% to ~1% over next 5m. Monitoring for 30m. :thumbsup:

acme-sre: Thanks, please share the postmortem and if you need us to change DNS SRV TTLs or remove the old VIP. We'll keep monitoring.

maya (support): We'll open a follow-up ticket for a postmortem and policy change: require 3/3 agent applies or fail rotation. Also recommend customers keep SRV records but alert on IPs that continue to serve old certs. 

liam (sre): Action items:
- infra: push haproxy agent verification fix (PR #784)
- rotator: require agent bundle checksum verify (ticket R-221)
- support: share mitigation notes with Acme

acme-sre: Appreciated. :thumbsup:

kevin (oncall): Marking resolved for now, re-open if 502s reappear.

maya (support): Thanks everyone. I'll draft the incident summary.
